SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices in Kurnool as a direct factory, not a marketplace reseller. We have built modular steel cabins since 2009 and completed 500+ projects across South India. Units for Kurnool are fabricated at our Bangalore works and sent by road up NH44 to sites across the city, the Kallur industrial estate, and the Orvakal industrial and airport belt. At about 380–420 km, most Kurnool orders reach the site in 3–4 days once the build is ready.

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin that arrives ready to use. It gives you a clean, lockable, weather-proof workspace without the delay and expense of on-site civil work. For a Rayalaseema region built on cement and limestone, mineral and stone processing, solar EPC across the district's power belt, and NH44 and NH40 logistics, a container office is the quickest way to set up a site office, engineer cabin, or security post exactly where the work is.

How we build our container offices

Every unit starts with a mild steel frame in IS 2062 structural steel, welded and treated to hold up in Kurnool's hot, dry Rayalaseema climate. The base sits on a channel frame so the cabin stays off wet ground. Walls use insulated PUF sandwich panels, or cement board with rockwool, so the inside stays workable through the peak summer heat. The roof is profiled GI sheet with a slope for rain runoff. Flooring is marine ply with vinyl for office use, or chequered MS plate for heavy gate and store cabins. A standard fit-out covers electrical wiring with switches, points, LED lights and a distribution board, powder-coated windows with grille and shutter, and a steel or laminated door with a lock. We add air-conditioning, toilets with plumbing, pantry units, and partition walls when a site needs them.

Common sizes for Kurnool sites

Popular configurations are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft for a single supervisor or security cabin, 20×8 ft (the standard shipping-container footprint) for a site office that seats a small team, and 40×8 ft for larger project offices with two or three rooms. We also fabricate to custom dimensions, and double-decker units where ground space is tight — a common need on compact Kallur estate plots and spread-out solar sites. If you are unsure of the size, tell us the headcount and the use, and we will suggest a layout that fits.

Where they are used around Kurnool

Buyers in the Kurnool region use our cabins as site and project offices on cement and mining works, engineer and supervisor cabins on solar EPC sites across the district, gate and security cabins for quarries and logistics yards on NH44, admin and store offices for units in the Kallur Industrial Estate (518003), and project offices across the Orvakal (518010) industrial and airport belt. For teams that want prefabricated office cabins for project sites, we build a hardened version with heavier flooring and extra power points.

Price factors and delivery

Container office price in Kurnool depends on the size, the panel type (PUF costs more than cement board but insulates better), the flooring, and add-ons like AC, a toilet, or extra electrical load. Because every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion rather than showing a fixed sticker price that would not match your actual build. Delivery to Kurnool is charged at ₹3,000 where applicable, with road transit of about 3–4 days once the unit is ready. We also offer a 7-day return window, with return shipping paid by the customer. Compare our specifications against any marketplace listing — the difference is that you are dealing with the factory that welds the frame, not an agent forwarding your enquiry.

Certifications and warranty

SAMAN Portable operates under ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and is registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our container offices carry a 5-year structural frame and base warranty, 1–2 years on finishing, and a 20–25 year engineered service life for the steel structure. These are real, verifiable credentials — the kind of manufacturer proof a marketplace listing cannot show you.

Why buy from SAMAN

Search for a container office on a directory and you get a list of resellers competing on the same stock photos. Enquire with SAMAN and you reach the manufacturer directly — honest specifications, real size options, transparent price factors, and one point of accountability from fabrication to dispatch. See the way we engineer our container offices to understand the standards we build to, and our work across the wider Deccan region — container office supply toward Hyderabad, container cabins for the Ballari belt, and Guntur area site office units — shows the same build quality reaches every Rayalaseema site.

Frequently asked questions

Do you deliver container offices to Kurnool and the Orvakal industrial belt?
Yes. We manufacture at our Bangalore factory and dispatch by road up NH44 to Kurnool city (518001), the Kallur Industrial Estate (518003), and the Orvakal industrial and airport belt (518010). Transit is usually 3–4 days once the unit is built, with delivery charged at ₹3,000 where applicable.

What container office sizes suit Kurnool cement and solar project sites?
Common sizes are 10×8 ft and 10×10 ft cabins, 20×8 ft site offices, and 40×8 ft project offices. We also build custom dimensions and double-decker units for compact estate plots and spread-out solar sites.

What does a container office cost in Kurnool?
Price depends on size, panel type, flooring, and add-ons like AC or a toilet. Since every unit is made to order, we confirm the final quote after a short requirement discussion so the figure matches your exact build.

Can the cabin be customised for cement, mining, and solar EPC sites?
Yes. We add AC, toilets, pantries, partitions, extra power points, and heavier flooring for gate or store use, and we match the layout to the headcount and space at your site.

Talk to the manufacturer. For container offices anywhere in the Kurnool region, call our South zone team on +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details for a made-to-order quote.
